fine_sensitive_vector: per core: mean density in [2:14]^3, (lambda3-lambda1)/sqrt(2), (lambda1-2lambda2+lambda3)/sqrt(6); two cores
scale: identity in dimensionless physical density/tidal units, no fitted whitening
covariance_role: development-summary nuisance fixture only, never model normalization or a calibration correction
primary_test: complete registered advancement rule; a rigorously relaxed necessary-event upper bound below 0.8 can reject Gate 2 early but can never pass it
qualification: conditional sensitivity under declared synthetic laws, not measured population power or posterior qualification
